scripts.bin:linux: bun build src/index.ts --compile --target=bun-linux-x64 --outfile bin/hc-linux-x64 && bun build src/index.ts --compile --target=bun-linux-arm64 --outfile bin/hc-linux-arm64
scripts.bin:mac: bun build src/index.ts --compile --target=bun-darwin-x64 --outfile bin/hc-mac-x64 && bun build src/index.ts --compile --target=bun-darwin-arm64 --outfile bin/hc-mac-arm64
scripts.bin:all: npm run bin:linux && npm run bin:mac && npm run bin:win
